contract.rule: Pass this object—and only this object—to downstream inference.

customer_message.body:
Hello

While the sequence is unclear: Yesterday dark water came up through the floor drain again; The manager sent only a cleaner; My photos have no timestamps, and we went to the pharmacy about my daughter's rash; this is what I can confirm.

Regarding “repeated sewage backflow with an alleged health effect and uncertainty about what is causing it”, my records show: the backflow source remains unresolved; for the request “arrange immediate containment and specialist inspection, then assess a repair deadline, official deposit, and documented costs”: some dates are not yet in a reliable order; on “repeated sewage backflow with an alleged health effect and uncertainty about what is causing it”, I want clarity before acting; also unresolved: the contamination extent; I cannot currently support anything further.

I am asking for: arrange immediate containment and specialist inspection, then assess a repair deadline, official deposit, and documented costs; in particular, I need clarity about the contamination extent and which dates reliably establish the chronology.

I need the chronology checked; It would help to know the backflow source; I want to base what I do on that.

I became aware of the problem on 23 September 2025.

Kind regards
customer_message.subject: Dates still need confirmation: repeated sewage backflow with an alleged health effect and uncertainty about what is causing it
